page.subtitle: Themes, style and personal touches for your harness.
language.label: Studio language
toast.focusOn: Focus mode on. Press Ctrl+K to leave it.
toast.noChat: Open a chat first, then insert the prompt.
toast.noChatCopied: No chat open, so the prompt was copied to your clipboard.
toast.clipboardBlocked: The browser wouldn't share your clipboard, so {clipboard} was left blank.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Every theme ships a light and a dark version. This switch picks which one you see.
windows.accentHint: Recolours the current theme's highlights to match Windows, and follows it when you change it.
themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Click to apply. Tip: press Ctrl+K and arrow through themes to preview them live.
themes.yoursDescription: Made in the theme editor, added from the gallery, or rolled by the dice.
themeDesc.liquid-glass: Clear frosted glass on true black, with magenta and cyan highlights.
themeDesc.midnight: Deep navy with a periwinkle glow.
themeDesc.catppuccin: Soft pastels: Mocha by night, Latte by day.
themeDesc.solarized: Precision colours for machines and people.
themeDesc.ocean: Deep water with a teal current.
themeDesc.synthwave: Hot-pink neon on a purple horizon.
themeDesc.paper: Warm sepia, easy on the eyes for long reads.
lookDesc.liquid-glass-desktop: Liquid Glass theme, frosted glass panels, your desktop wallpaper behind them, rounder corners.
looks.title: Saved looks
looks.description: A look remembers your theme, style and wallpaper together, so you can switch whole setups in one click.
looks.namePlaceholder: Name this look, e.g. Late night
looks.empty: No saved looks yet. Set things up how you like them, then save the look.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Switch themes or looks by time of day, e.g. a light theme in the morning and Liquid Glass at night.
schedule.hint: Checked every 30 seconds. Changing the theme yourself sticks until the next switch time.
editor.title: Theme editor
editor.description: Pick three colours per mode. The editor derives every surface, border and text shade from them, keeping text readable.
editor.name: Name
editor.livePreview: Preview across the whole app while editing
editor.livePreviewHint: Leaving this tab without saving puts your current theme back.
editor.fromImageDescription: Studio picks a background, text and accent from a picture's colours and checks they're readable.
editor.fromImageDone: Theme made from the image. Tweak it, then save.
editor.fromImageFailed: Couldn't make a theme from that image: {error}
editor.codeHint: Paste a code someone shared with you, or copy yours to share.
editor.codeInvalid: That isn't a Studio theme code (they start with dshs1:).
editor.imported: Imported “{name}”. Save it to keep it.
gallery.title: Community gallery
gallery.description: Themes shared by Studio users. Click one to add it to your themes and apply it.
gallery.empty: The gallery is empty right now. Check back soon, or be the first to submit a theme.
gallery.submitDescription: Make a theme in the editor and press “Submit to the gallery”. GitHub opens with the file ready, and you propose it from there.
style.customFontHint: Any CSS font-family list, e.g. "Satoshi", sans-serif. The font must be installed.
style.fontHint: Fonts fall back gracefully if one isn't installed.
style.folderPlaceholder: C:\path\to\fonts (files there are served to this app only)
style.accentBubblesHint: Your messages pick up the theme's accent colour.
style.accentSelectionHint: Highlighted text uses the accent colour.
layout.title: Layout
layout.description: How wide the conversation runs, how big everything is, and a distraction-free focus mode.
layout.hint: Focus mode folds the sidebar and side panel away. Ctrl+K → Focus mode toggles it from anywhere.
material.title: Material
material.description: Liquid glass turns the sidebar, composer, cards, bubbles and menus into frosted, see-through panes. Best over a wallpaper.
material.sheenHint: A bright top rim and a soft diagonal reflection on every pane.
material.found: {count} glass surfaces found in this harness version.
material.finding: Finding the harness's surfaces… (menus are glass already)
ambience.title: Ambience
ambience.description: A subtle full-screen effect layered over the app. It never blocks clicks.
wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.description: An image behind the conversation. Surfaces turn translucent so it shows through.
wallpaper.followingDesktop: Following your Windows desktop wallpaper. Change it in Windows and Studio picks it up.
wallpaper.urlHint: https:// links work; uploads are resized and stored in your settings file.
identity.youDescription: Used by the greeting and, if you turn it on, by the AI's personal preferences.
identity.name: Your name
identity.brandDescription: Rename the app and swap the logo in the sidebar and on the new-chat screen. Leave blank to keep the originals.
identity.removeImage: Remove this image and use the DeepSeek logo
identity.imageRemoved: Image removed. Back to the DeepSeek logo.
identity.greetingDescription: Replaces the headline on the new-chat screen.
persona.title: Personal preferences for the AI
persona.description: Like custom instructions: Studio adds a short section to the system prompt for every agent turn.
persona.enable: Send my preferences to the model
persona.enableHint: Applies from the next message. Changing them makes the model re-read its whole prompt once (a cache miss), so tweak, then leave it.
persona.aboutHint: Your role, what you're working on, your experience level…
persona.aboutPlaceholder: e.g. I'm a backend developer; comfortable with JS, newer to Rust.
persona.languageHint: e.g. British English. Blank = whatever you write in.
persona.instructionsHint: Anything else, in your own words.
persona.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always show the full file when you change one. Prefer pnpm. Don't add comments unless asked.
persona.previewOff: Off. Nothing is sent until you turn it on.
persona.previewEmpty: (nothing yet: fill in a field above)
persona.styleHint.concise: Tight replies: the answer first, no filler, short paragraphs or bullets.
persona.styleHint.thorough: Explains the reasoning, edge cases and trade-offs, with examples.
persona.styleHint.friendly: Warm and conversational, with a little humour, never at the cost of accuracy.
persona.styleHint.mentor: Teaches as it goes: why each step works and what's worth learning.
persona.styleHint.butler: A calm, impeccably polite AI butler with a dry wit.
persona.styleHint.hype: Upbeat and energetic, celebrates progress, keeps it punchy.
prompts.title: Saved prompts
prompts.description: Insert one with the ✦ button beside the composer, by typing /prompts, or from Ctrl+K.
prompts.folderHint: Optional. Prompts with the same folder are grouped together.
prompts.textHint: Inserted at your cursor. Placeholders like {clipboard} and {ask:Topic} are filled in when you insert it.
prompts.placeholdersDescription: Put these in a prompt's text and Studio fills them in when you insert it.
prompts.ph.ask: asks you for it when you insert the prompt
prompts.packsDescription: Share all your prompts as one code, or add a pack someone shared with you. Duplicates are skipped.
prompts.packShare: Copy my prompts as a pack
prompts.packInvalid: That isn't a Studio prompt pack (they start with dshp1:).
composer.title: Saved prompts
alerts.title: Task alerts
alerts.description: Get a desktop notification and a sound when a task finishes, or when the agent needs you to approve or answer something.
alerts.onlyAwayHint: Stays quiet while this window is focused.
alerts.needsInput: Also when it needs my input
alerts.needsInputHint: Approvals, questions and other prompts that pause the agent.
alerts.permission.default: Your browser will ask to allow notifications.
alerts.permission.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
alerts.permission.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. The sound still works.
alerts.testBody: This is what a finished task looks like.
alerts.notifyInputBody: It's waiting for an approval or an answer.
usage.title: Usage & cost
usage.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Studio counts tokens from every model call from now on.
usage.chartLabel: Tokens per day for the last 30 days
usage.modelsDescription: Prices are per million tokens, in US dollars. Fill them in from your provider's price list to see spend.
usage.balanceDescription: Asks DeepSeek for your account balance with the {env} key the harness already uses.
usage.unavailable: not enough balance for new calls
sync.title: Settings sync
sync.description: Back up your Studio settings to a private GitHub Gist and restore them on any computer.
sync.howTo: Create a GitHub token with only the “gist” permission, paste it here, and Studio keeps it on this computer. It never leaves the harness except to talk to GitHub.
sync.restoreConfirm: Replace my settings with the backup
sync.autoHint: A minute after you change something.
sync.imagesHint: Uploaded wallpapers and logos. They can make the backup large.
advanced.cssDescription: Applied last, on top of everything. Use the --dsw-* design tokens to stay theme-aware.
updates.title: Updates
updates.unreachable: Couldn't reach Studio's updater. Restart DeepSeek Harness, then try again.
updates.autoHint: Studio checks GitHub every 6 hours and installs new versions by itself; they take effect when you next restart DeepSeek Harness.
updates.allVersionsDescription: Install any release: update to a newer one, reinstall this one, or downgrade if a new version gives you trouble.
updates.nothingYet: Nothing here yet. Press Check for updates.
updates.installingDesc: This takes a few seconds. Your settings were backed up first.
updates.installedDesc: Restart DeepSeek Harness to finish: close the app and open it again, or stop dsh web and run it again.
updates.downgradeWarning: Downgrade to v{version}? Auto-updates switch off so Studio doesn't jump straight back. Your settings are backed up first; anything the older version doesn't know about is dropped from its settings.
updates.preUpdaterWarning: v{version} doesn't have this Updates page. To come back to the latest version later, use {add}.
updates.blocker.local-copy: This copy of Studio is linked from a folder on this computer (a developer install), so its updates come from that folder. For one-click updates, install it from GitHub: {add}.
updates.blocker.not-from-github: This copy wasn't installed from GitHub, so it can't update itself. Reinstall it from GitHub: {add}.
updates.blocker.no-plugin-manager: This harness doesn't let plugins use its plugin manager, so update from the Plugins page instead.
updates.blocker.no-repository: This copy doesn't say where its releases live, so it can't check for updates.
credits.tagline: Themes and personal touches for DeepSeek Harness.
credits.builtOnText: by DeepSeek, released under the MIT licence. Studio plugs into its theme, slot and plugin systems; the whale logo restored by “Original” is DeepSeek's own mark.
credits.palettesDescription: These presets are adapted from open-source colour schemes. Some light-mode accents are darkened so text stays readable.
credits.translationsText: Studio speaks 19 languages. Spotted a clumsy phrase? Improvements are welcome in

palette.label: Quick switcher
palette.backup: Back up settings to GitHub now
command.themeDescription: Switch your Studio theme or look
command.promptsDescription: Insert one of your Studio prompts
command.focusDescription: Hide the sidebar and side panel, or bring them back
